scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.qa:smoke: npm --prefix frontend run test:smoke && npm --prefix backend run test:smoke
scripts.qa:browser: npm --prefix frontend run test:e2e && npm --prefix frontend run test:e2e:sw
scripts.qa: npm run qa:smoke && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm run qa:browser && npm run qa:native
